description: This file defines the data model and network API for remote notes synchronization in a note-taking app. It includes the 'RemoteNote' struct, the 'RemoteNotesAPI' protocol, and two implementations: 'URLSessionRemoteNotesAPI' for real network communication and 'MockRemoteNotesAPI' for testing.

classes.name: URLSessionRemoteNotesAPI
classes.description: Implementation of 'RemoteNotesAPI' using URLSession for network requests.

classes.name: MockRemoteNotesAPI
classes.description: Mock implementation of 'RemoteNotesAPI' for testing purposes.

methods.name: pullNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the remote backend via GET request.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Sends local notes to the remote backend via POST request.

methods.name: validateHTTPResponse
methods.description: Validates HTTP response status and throws errors for non-success status codes.
